findings.description: The bucket is explicitly noted and configured as public with no ACL restriction, exposing potentially sensitive data (customer master file) to unauthenticated internet access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest.
Versioning is not enabled, so objects can be overwritten or deleted without recovery, increasing impact of accidental or malicious modification given the bucket is also public.
A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded into the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving stored objects unencrypted at rest.
Versioning is not enabled for the financials bucket, risking permanent data loss or undetected tampering of financial records.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so operations data is stored unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so data science bucket contents are stored unencrypted at rest.
